activities.name: Angels Support Operation
activities.description: Next stop: the live venue to make all Delulus' hearts skip a beat! Participate in the version event to get the Angels of Delusion's limited outfits!

activities.name: Spooky Funhouse Tales
activities.description: During Spooky Funhouse Tales, players can operate different Trickmobiles to drive away unwanted guests. Event rewards include an Angels of Delusion outfit, a new A-Rank W-Engine, and Proxy accessories.
